answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 60583 Country: India Title: Dua for niyat of roza(fast) Question: Is there some dua to make niyat for fardh sawm (in Ramadan) or nafl sawm? Answer ID: 60583 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 712/677/SN=10/1436) No, no special dua is recorded in Hadiths about it. Just one should make intention in his heart that he shall keep fast tomorrow. It is enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
